text: 奥迪中国发布声明：近期，为切实维护海外消费者合法权益，奥迪总部已针对海外未经官方授权销售AUDI车型的进口商开展相关法律行动。奥迪总部的声明系针对目前海外未经官方授权销售的进口商行为，并切实保护海外消费者相关权益做出的提醒。相关报道意在表达欧洲的奥迪经销商网络无法对目前进入欧洲市场非官方支持的平行进口AUDI车辆提供售后服务保障，而非对品牌的不认可。但有相关报道给公众带来了误解，对AUDI品牌形象造成影响。在此，我们严正声明并澄清AUDI品牌是奥迪在华成立的全新电动品牌，是奥迪双品牌战略的重要支柱。（奥迪中国微信公号）
text_en: Audi China issued a statement: Recently, in order to effectively protect the lawful rights and interests of overseas consumers, Audi headquarters has initiated relevant legal actions against overseas importers that sell AUDI models without official authorization. The statement by Audi headquarters is a reminder aimed at the current behavior of overseas importers selling without official authorization and at effectively protecting the relevant rights and interests of overseas consumers. The relevant reports are intended to convey that the Audi dealer network in Europe cannot provide after-sales service guarantees for parallel-imported AUDI vehicles currently entering the European market without official support, rather than expressing disapproval of the brand. However, relevant reports have caused public misunderstanding and affected the AUDI brand image. Here, we solemnly state and clarify that the AUDI brand is a brand-new electric brand established by Audi in China and an important pillar of Audi's dual-brand strategy. (Audi China WeChat official account)
